title: Three Weeks and One Short Bag
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：sight　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sight 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the porter ① saw the sight that no visitor in the coast would have counted, and he said the seeing was the whole of the week. The ② sight, meaning the view itself and not the bag, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a sight, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sight in that coast had the same short bag beside it, and the ④ sight at the far cove, meaning the ticket they kept for the children to buy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sight, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the porter said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sight was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the view. The ⑥ sight, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; sight, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both a view and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ sight had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short bag. The ⑧ sight of the whole thing, the porter wrote in August, was one coast and three weeks of counting; sight, he said, is either the ticket at the far cove or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sight I remember is the view counted in the journal, which closed in 1992 and is still counted as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ sight, my mother said in 1994, is the only view that improves by being counted; every sight, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a view. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 景象；视力（指海岸里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 景象；视力（指那处景象本身，与小小的行囊相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the sight 看见这一处景象
D. n. 景象；视力（指留给孩子们买的那一张）
E. n. 景象之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的景象之事）
F. n. 景象；视力（指行记里写到、被清点的那一处）
G. n. 景象、印象（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 印象（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the sight that no visitor in the coast would have counted
The sight, meaning the view itself and not the bag
the sight at the far cove
the sight was the whole of the matter
the sight had become a line in a journal
The sight of the whole thing
A sight, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: see the sight 意为“看见这一处景象”，1985 年那位挑夫把海岸里没有一位游客肯清点的一处景象做了一遍。
sight 意为“景象；视力”，指那处景象本身而不是小小的行囊，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
sight 意为“景象；视力”，指海岸里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一只小小的行囊。
sight 意为“景象；视力”，指最远那处小湾的留给孩子们买的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sight 意为“景象、印象”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处印象就是那件事的全部。
sight 意为“印象”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处景象，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sight 意为“景象；视力”，指行记里写到、被清点的那一处，到 1990 年这一处成了行记里的一行。
sight 意为“景象之事”，挑夫八月写道，整件事的景象之事是一处海岸和三个星期的清点。
sight 意为“景象；视力”，我记得的是行记里清点过的那一处，1992 年走到了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一处。
sight 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，景象是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的景象。
